messages:
anya: Kicking off short thread for cust-aquila LoRA bring-up onto oak-13b-v2.1. Quick-eval flagged token-id reshuffle for the pound sign and a measurable int4 regression. Posting findings here.
mira: Short summary please.
anya: Their tokenizer adds <INV_REF> and <CUST_NOTE>, and it renumbers a block in the high vocab range. Naive merge created a few split tokens for '£' and some ordinal punctuation, which affects detokenization.
kevin: Any runtime issues when testing long contexts/streaming?
anya: Hit one streaming mismatch during batched playback:
```
RuntimeError: kv_cache size mismatch (expected 24, got 20)
  at runtime/kv_store.cc:211
```
Root cause: model.config.max_position_embeddings left at 4096; customer uses ~7000. Raised to 8192 locally and the problem disappeared. Also found a subtle assumption in our token->kv layout about contiguous vocab ids; added a defensive check.
yuki: What do quick-eval numbers show? concise numbers.
anya: Invoice extraction quickpack (600 samples):
- oak-13b-v2.1 fp16 baseline: EM=0.85 F1=0.92
- aquila-lora merged fp16: EM=0.83 F1=0.90
- aquila-lora merged int4 (per-channel asym): EM=0.78 F1=0.87
Quantization accounts for most of the degradation; token detokenize drift adds a ~0.01 EM gap.
mira: Give 1-2 failing examples (minimal).
anya: Example: 
```
input: "Total due: £1,250.00"
baseline: "Total due: £1,250.00"
merged-fp16: "Total due: £1,250.00"
merged-int4: "Total due 1250.00 pounds"
```
The pound sign got token-split in candidate tokenizer into [412, 3887] causing spacing changes. Another sample: "Order #42 — Due 05/01/2025" -> candidate removed em-dash spacing.
kevin: Run token diff and attach minimal mapping snippet.
anya: token_diff snippet: `£ => base:[3188] candidate:[412,3887] ; "—" => base:[184] candidate:[184]`. Split for £ occurs on ~0.3% of quickpack samples (> preflight 0.1%).
yuki: Two remediation options: (A) reindex LoRA embeddings to base tokenizer ids (accurate but requires weight rewrite & verification), (B) add a lightweight preprocess/postprocess collapse map to recompose known split sequences into single logical tokens during detokenize and evaluation.
mira: Any quant sims or QAT runs to estimate int4 hit?
anya: Ran a quick quant_sim (per-channel asymmetric) and a 500-step QAT sim restricted to LoRA params. eval-bot uploaded artifacts.
eval-bot: quant_sim summary: per-channel int4 projected EM delta = -0.05 vs merged-fp16; QAT (500 steps) projected EM delta = -0.02. Artifacts: /artifacts/aquila/1839876543/quant_sim.json and /artifacts/aquila/1839876543/qat_sim.json
kevin: For short-term rollout, recommend canary the merged-fp16 variant (no quant) at a small percentage, hold int4 until either token-aligned remerge or QAT recovers EM within 0.03. Add fallback policy on production: revert to oak-13b if EM_drop >= 0.035 over sliding 1k requests.
anya: Implemented a quick preprocess that collapses [412,3887] -> '£' and normalizes common currency token patterns for eval. Reran int4 quickpack: EM improved 0.78 -> 0.80. Better but still shy of fp16-merged. Patch and diffs in GH.
mira: Please file an onboard ticket and include token dumps + failing samples.
anya: Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/customer-onboards/issues/4510 — includes token mappings, failing examples, quant/QAT artifacts, and suggested remediation steps.
yuki: I'll add a token-drift check into quick-eval: any base symbol token that maps to >1 candidate tokens for >0.1% of samples will flag the merge and block auto-rollout. Also add a quick token-diff summary to the eval report.
kevin: Action items: (1) anya: expand preprocess remap to other splits and rerun short evals, (2) kevin: experiment with token-aligned remerge / reindex LoRA weights and run a full QAT (1k steps) if feasible, (3) mira: start fp16 canary (5%) with fallback rule, (4) yuki: add token-drift preflight and CI alert.
deploy-bot: Canary requested: aquila-lora-fp16 -> dedicated/pool-6 (5%). Fallback: revert when EM_drop >= 0.035 sliding window 1k requests.
kevin: We'll pause int4 rollout until we have either a token-aligned remerge that preserves symbol tokens or QAT projected EM within threshold. Reopen thread with final artifacts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
